releaseNotes:
Default motor mapping to production wiring (X=id0, Y=id1)

The rev0 rebind (9ba851c) moved the X/Y steppers to id=2/id=3, but the
actual field device drives X on id=0 and Y on id=1 (confirmed from the
captured device DB). Realign the seed to production:

- hardware_features: MOTOR_X_* portNum 2->0, MOTOR_Y_* portNum 3->1
- hardware_ports: motor-0/1 = X/Y axis, motor-2/3 = spare (keeps the
  feature table and the role registry consistent, since the runtime
  reads portNum from features but HardwareRoleResolver reads num from
  ports — both must agree)
- defaultPortFor (admin add-feature UI) X->0, Y->1
- restore the device's tuned values: MOTOR_X_HOME rpm 80, Y mixing
  pos 40, Y clean pos 65

Seeding is back-fill only, so this affects freshly provisioned tablets;
deployed devices keep their existing rows.
